name: etsy-ecommerce-channels-mcp
description: Etsy (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, create_listing, update_listing, end_listin

platform_mcp_etsy_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_client_id.description: Etsy App API Key keystring (etsy.com/developers/your-apps); sent as client_id in the refresh grant form body (Etsy's refresh grant takes no client secret).

platform_mcp_etsy_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_etsy_api_key.description: Value of the x-api-key header required on every v3 request: the keystring and the shared secret joined by a colon, e.g. 1aa2bb33c44d55eeeeee6fff:a1b2c3d4e5 (both on the Your Apps page).

platform_mcp_etsy_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_etsy_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (numeric user id prefix, e.g. 12345678.JNGI...) from a one-time OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE consent at etsy.com/oauth/connect with scopes shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w; valid 90 days, after which the seller consents again. Access tokens (1 h) are minted from it. A refresh grant also returns a new refresh token, which replaces the old one. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start.

platform_mcp_etsy_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_shop_id.description: Numeric Etsy shop id (GET /v3/application/users/me returns it as shop_id).

platform_mcp_etsy_taxonomy_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_TAXONOMY_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_taxonomy_id.description: Seller taxonomy id every created listing is filed under (GET /v3/application/seller-taxonomy/nodes); required by create_listing.

platform_mcp_etsy_who_made.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHO_MADE
platform_mcp_etsy_who_made.description: createDraftListing who_made for new listings: i_did | someone_else | collective; required by create_listing.

platform_mcp_etsy_when_made.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHEN_MADE
platform_mcp_etsy_when_made.description: createDraftListing when_made for new listings, e.g. made_to_order, 2020_2026, 2010_2019, before_2007; required by create_listing.

platform_mcp_etsy_shipping_profile_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHIPPING_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/shipping-profiles); required for physical listings.

platform_mcp_etsy_readiness_state_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_READINESS_STATE_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_readiness_state_id.description: Processing profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/readiness-state-definitions); required for physical listings.

platform_mcp_etsy_return_policy_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_RETURN_POLICY_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_return_policy_id.description: Optional return policy id for new listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/policies/return).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v3/application/users/me (scope shops_r) returns {user_id, shop_id} for the seller who granted the token.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/receipts?limit(1-100)&offset&min_created (scope transactions_r). `since` must be a UNIX timestamp in seconds (min_created is an epoch integer; an ISO date is rejected as invalid_input). `status` is ignored: Etsy filters with booleans (was_paid, was_shipped, was_canceled), not a status string. Returns {count, results[ShopReceipt]}; receipt `status` is paid|completed|open|payment processing|canceled|...; created_at is epoch seconds; `total` is not mapped because grandtotal is {amount, divisor, currency_code} in minor units (see raw.grandtotal).

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: POST /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/receipts/{receipt_id}/tracking {tracking_code, carrier_name} (JSON body, scope transactions_w) submits tracking and notifies the buyer; returns the updated ShopReceipt, whose `status` is reported.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: POST /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/listings (createDraftListing, scope listings_w) as application/x-www-form-urlencoded, as documented: title, description, price, quantity from the arguments; who_made, when_made, taxonomy_id, shipping_profile_id, readiness_state_id and return_policy_id from the config fields; type=physical. Etsy requires quantity and description (optional in this vocabulary) and they must be passed. Creates a DRAFT (state draft): publishing needs at least one image (uploadListingImage, multipart, not mapped) and then updateListing state=active. `sku`, `currency` (the shop's) and `image_urls` are ignored. Returns the ShopListing {listing_id, url, state}.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/listings/{listing_id} (updateListing, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, scope listings_w) with the given title / description. `price` and `quantity` are NOT updateListing fields: on Etsy they live in the inventory offerings (updateListingInventory, see not_offered.set_inventory) and are ignored here. Returns the ShopListing; `status` is its state.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PATCH /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/listings/{listing_id} state=inactive (form-encoded) deactivates the listing: unsearchable and unsellable, reversible with state=active (Listings tutorial lifecycle table). deleteListing is not used.
